description.value: Sunshine Coast Arena is a publicly operated ice hockey facility managed by the Sunshine Coast Regional District, serving the Sechelt area. It is listed among SCRD's core recreation facilities alongside aquatic centres and community halls. Touring cyclists passing through Sechelt may find it a convenient landmark, though it is primarily a sporting venue rather than a dedicated cycling destination.
